style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Prelit Twig 4ft Christmas Tree With 420 Constant LED Lights
style.toneOfVoice: Our 4ft Pre-Lit Golden Twig Tree is the centrepiece you’ve been looking for. With 420 constant LED warm white lights illuminating its slender golden branches, this tree glows with a rich, luxurious warmth that transforms any room, whether it’s nestled in a hallway, bedroom, or living room. The golden finish catches the light beautifully, adding shimmer and depth to the branches and creating a look that’s simultaneously bold and refined. Unlike a traditional Christmas tree, the open twig silhouette gives the lights room to breathe, allowing the glow to radiate. At 4ft tall, it works equally well as a standalone statement piece or alongside other decorations. The 420 pre-fitted LEDs mean it’s ready to glow from the moment you plug it in – no additional lighting required. Ideal for: Hallways and other floor areas, bedrooms, home offices, and glamorous or maximalist Christmas interiors. 420 CONSTANT WARM WHITE LEDS: Pre-fitted with 420 constant warm white LEDs for a steady, uninterrupted warm golden glow – no flicker, no fuss. Simply plug in and let it shine. GLAMOROUS GOLDEN TWIG DESIGN: Rich golden finish with an open twig silhouette that allows light to radiate outward, filling the surrounding space with a warm, luxurious glow. BOLD STATEMENT PIECE: A design-led alternative to the traditional Christmas tree – works beautifully as a standalone statement in hallways, entryways, or other floor spaces. FUSS-FREE PRE-LIT SETUP: No additional lights required. Pliable branches shape easily to your preferred look. Plug-in power source, CE certified for UK and EU use. PLEASE NOTE: For indoor use only. Keep away from heat sources and open flame. Height: 4ft (122cm). Assembly required. Dimensions(mm): Height: 1220. Width: 550. Depth: 550.
